description: This file defines an Android Service class 'AdvertiserService' responsible for managing Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) advertising. It initializes BLE advertising, handles start/stop operations, manages timeouts, and communicates status via broadcasts.

classes.name: AdvertiserService
classes.description: An Android Service that manages BLE advertising, including lifecycle, timeouts, and callbacks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up advertising, and starts timeout mechanism.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, stops advertising, and cancels timeout.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as the service does not support binding.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up Bluetooth advertiser object if not already initialized.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Schedules a runnable to stop advertising after a fixed timeout duration.

methods.name: startAdvertising
methods.description: Starts BLE advertising with specified settings and data.

methods.name: buildAdvertiseData
methods.description: Creates AdvertiseData including service UUID and device name.

methods.name: buildAdvertiseSettings
methods.description: Creates AdvertiseSettings configured for low power and no built-in timeout.

methods.name: sendFailureIntent
methods.description: Broadcasts an intent signaling advertising failure with an error code.
